observations: Photo 0 shows a blue console wrapped in plastic, with a gold PS4 logo (triangle, circle, cross, square) on top. The console appears to be a custom or special edition, not a standard PS4 Slim.
Photo 1 shows the same console from a slightly different angle, with a custom controller in front. The controller has a blue and grey camouflage pattern.
Photo 2 shows the console from a side angle, with the controller placed on top. The console has a textured blue surface with the same gold PS4 logo.
The console is not a standard PS4 Slim; it appears to be a custom or limited edition model, possibly a 'Blue Customised' variant.
The controller is a standard DualShock 4, but with a custom camouflage design, not the original PlayStation branding.
No games, cables, or other accessories are visible in any photo.
The seller claims '10 latest games' including FIFA and PES 2027, but no games are shown in any photo.
